description: This file contains unit tests for the ObserverManager class, testing its behavior under various scenarios such as concurrent modifications, observer expiration, and exception handling.

classes.name: ObserverManagerTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the ObserverManager class, verifying its correctness and robustness.

methods.name: CollectionModified
methods.description: Tests that modifying the observer collection during notification does not cause exceptions.

methods.name: SubscribeDuringNotify_ObserversAreUpdatedImmediately
methods.description: Verifies that observers added during notification are immediately visible and not notified in the current cycle.

methods.name: UnsubscribeDuringNotify_ObserversAreUpdatedImmediately
methods.description: Checks that observers unsubscribed during notification are not notified and are removed from the collection.

methods.name: SyncNotify_SubscribeAndUnsubscribe_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Tests synchronous notification with concurrent subscribe and unsubscribe operations.

methods.name: ExceptionInNotificationCallback_RemovesObserver
methods.description: Ensures that an observer causing an exception during notification is removed from the collection.

methods.name: SyncNotify_ExceptionInNotificationCallback_RemovesObserver
methods.description: Same as above but for synchronous notification.

methods.name: ExpiredObservers_AreRemovedDuringNotify
methods.description: Verifies that expired observers are removed during notification.

methods.name: ClearExpired_RemovesOnlyExpiredObservers
methods.description: Tests that only expired observers are removed when clearing expired entries.

methods.name: Clear_RemovesAllObservers
methods.description: Checks that clearing the observer collection empties it entirely.

methods.name: CanModifyObserversConcurrently
methods.description: Tests concurrent modifications and notifications to ensure thread safety.

methods.name: PredicateFiltersObserversToNotify
methods.description: Verifies filtering of observers based on a predicate during notification.

methods.name: AsyncPredicateFiltersObserversToNotify
methods.description: Verifies filtering of observers with an asynchronous predicate.

methods.name: EnumeratorWorksCorrectly
methods.description: Tests that enumeration over observers works correctly.

methods.name: SubscribingExistingObserver_UpdatesLastSeenTime
methods.description: Checks that subscribing an existing observer updates its last seen timestamp.

methods.name: SubscribingExistingObserver_UpdatesObserverValue
methods.description: Verifies that subscribing with the same ID updates the observer's value.

methods.name: SetExpirationDuration_AffectsExpiration
methods.description: Tests that changing the expiration duration affects observer expiration as expected.

methods.name: ClearDuringNotification_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies that clearing observers during notification does not cause issues.

methods.name: ModifyDuringEnumeration_WorksWithoutExceptions
methods.description: Ensures that modifying the collection during enumeration does not cause exceptions and behaves as expected.
